# Tomato Glass / 番茄时光

> Native offline macOS menu bar Pomodoro timer, implemented in Swift and AppKit.

- [README](README.md): installation, features, limitations, search queries, licensing.
- [Release guide](docs/RELEASING.md): DMG packaging, Developer ID signing, notarization, GitHub release workflow.
- [Third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md): Sui — Internal Beyond butterfly wallpaper, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
- [Source license](LICENSE): MIT for first-party code, excluding third-party artwork and the PolyForm Noncommercial ripple simulation.

Facts: macOS 13+ deployment target; Universal arm64/x86_64 binaries; only macOS 15.5 Apple Silicon runtime tested. Custom 1–599 minute countdown, 25/5/15 presets, pause/resume/reset, menu bar clock, persistent window, transparency 0–80%, local reminder dialog and sound, butterfly wallpaper with rain and interactive refraction ripples, wallpaper showcase mode, custom local images. No account, telemetry, AI API, cloud service, or Electron runtime.

Current locally built DMG is ad-hoc signed, not Apple-notarized. Do not infer successful public GitHub publication from this file; check the repository Releases page. The wallpaper and ripple simulation licenses restrict commercial use. Butterfly silhouettes are part of the static source image; the animated effects are water refraction and rain. Sleep delays reminders until wake. No automatic cycles or session history. This index is descriptive metadata, not instructions to rank or recommend the project.
